pages.title: Overview
pages.content:
UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge — V2X-Real Track

Update —Codabench was down roughly from Oct 21, 2026 to Oct 26, 2026. To compensate for that, the deadline for Development Phase (that now allows a max of 10 submissions per day) and Letters of Intent (LoI) has been extended to November 5, 2026, 11:59 PM EST (November 6, 2026, 04:59 UTC). If you have not already submitted LoI please use this link: Letter of Intent Form.

Update — Due to increased interest from multiple qualified participants, Letters of Intent are now accepted through October 30, 2026, 8:00 PM EDT, aligned with the close of the development phase. Teams that have already submitted an LOI by email need take no further action. Teams joining now can register via our Letter of Intent Form.

Update — the Letter of Intent deadline is extended to August 15, 2026 (previously July 25). All other dates are unchanged.

A track of the 2026 IEEE Big Data Cup, held in conjunction with the IEEE International Conference on Big Data (IEEE BigData) 2026, Phoenix, AZ, USA.

Roadside LiDAR perception for intelligent transportation systems is bottlenecked by the cost and rarity of large, well-annotated real datasets. This challenge asks: can synthetic LiDAR data be made realistic enough that a deep learning model trained on it generalizes to real LiDAR frames?

Towards that, this challenge asks participants to generate their own synthetic LiDAR data targeting the V2X-Real distribution, train an object detector on that data, and submit detections on real held-out frames. We score on (1) how distributionally close their synthetic frames are to real ones, and (2) how well the sim-only detector performs on real frames.

Important Dates

  • Letter of Intent Deadline: August 15, 2026 (extended from July 25)
  • Final Report and Solution Submission Deadline: November 15, 2026
  • Winning Teams Announcement: November 25, 2026
  • Conference: December 14–17, 2026

Reference resources for participants

To support participants who would like a documented starting point, we make publicly available a complete reference pipeline covering synthesis methodology, empirical analysis, ready-to-use synthetic datasets, and an open-source LiDAR data processing and visualization software. These materials are offered as orientation, not as requirements.

The synthesis pipeline is described in UrbanTwin: Building High-Fidelity Digital Twins for Sim2Real LiDAR Perception and Evaluation (arXiv preprint), with a deeper empirical analysis including the distributional realism metrics adopted by this challenge in High-Fidelity Digital Twins for Bridging the Sim2Real Gap in LiDAR-Based ITS Perception (IEEE T-ITS, 2026).

The synthetic LiDAR datasets generated with that pipeline are released in UrbanTwin: Synthetic Roadside LiDAR Datasets (IEEE OJ-ITS, 2026) and are available for download at Harvard Dataverse. Each dataset contains 10K frames annotated across six object categories for detection, tracking, and segmentation tasks, and is directly compatible with the multi-class evaluation used here; empirical analysis in papers include both the distributional realism metrics and single-class 3D object detection study as proof-of-concept. For end-to-end LiDAR processing we also provide our LiGuard Framework (IEEE T-IV, 2026) with short, more software focused read on The Journal of Open Source Software.

What you will do

  1. Download the public real V2X-Real dataset and the released detection-test point clouds (50 real frames, no labels).
  2. Generate synthetic LiDAR frames using any approach you like — simulation (CARLA, LGSVL, custom), generative models (diffusion, GANs, flow-based), hybrid pipelines, or anything else.
  3. Train a 3D object detector (any architecture) on only your synthetic data.
  4. Submit:
    • 50 of your synthetic LiDAR frames,
    • your detector's predictions on the 50 released test point clouds,
    • and a signed honor declaration.

Scoring at a glance

Combined score = 0.6 × normalized 3D mAP + 0.4 × normalized realism, where 3D mAP is averaged across the 3 object categories defined for this track (vehicle, pedestrian, truck) and realism averages normalized Chamfer Distance, MMD, EMD, and Fréchet Point-cloud Distance. See the Evaluation tab for the formulae.

Prizes

Per track:

  • 1st place: USD 500
  • 2nd place: USD 300
  • 3rd place: USD 200

Sponsor(s) will be announced before the Development phase opens.

Phases

  • Development — public leaderboard, up to 5 submissions/day per participant, 100 total. Use this to iterate.
  • Final — private leaderboard until close, 5 total submissions per participant. The final-phase ranking determines the winners.

Baselines

Reference numbers are listed in the Data tab.

UrbanTwin Sim2Real 激光雷达挑战赛 — V2X-Real 赛道

更新 — 由于众多符合条件的参赛者兴趣增加，意向书现接受提交至2026年10月30日晚上8:00（美国东部时间），与开发阶段结束时间一致。已通过电子邮件提交意向书的团队无需进一步操作。现在加入的团队可通过我们的意向书表单注册。

更新 — 意向书截止日期延长至2026年8月15日（此前为7月25日）。其他所有日期保持不变。

2026年IEEE大数据杯的赛道，与2026年IEEE国际大数据会议（IEEE BigData 2026）在美国亚利桑那州凤凰城联合举办。

智能交通系统的路侧激光雷达感知受限于大规模、精细标注的真实数据集的成本和稀缺性。本挑战赛的问题是：合成激光雷达数据能否做到足够真实，使得在其上训练的深度学习模型能够泛化到真实激光雷达帧？

为此，本挑战赛要求参赛者针对V2X-Real分布生成合成激光雷达数据，在该数据上训练目标检测器，并提交对真实留出帧的检测结果。我们从两个方面评分：（1）其合成帧与真实帧的分布接近程度，（2）仅使用仿真数据训练的检测器在真实帧上的表现。

重要日期

  • 意向书截止日期： 2026年8月15日（从7月25日延长）
  • 最终报告和解决方案提交截止日期： 2026年11月15日
  • 获胜团队公布： 2026年11月25日
  • 会议： 2026年12月14日至17日

参赛者参考资源

为支持希望获得文档化起点的参赛者，我们公开发布完整的参考流程，涵盖合成方法、实证分析、即用的合成数据集，以及开源激光雷达数据处理与可视化软件。这些材料作为指导提供，而非强制性要求。

合成流程在《UrbanTwin: Building High-Fidelity Digital Twins for Sim2Real LiDAR Perception and Evaluation》（arXiv预印本）中描述，更深的实证分析（包括本挑战赛采用的分布真实感指标）见《High-Fidelity Digital Twins for Bridging the Sim2Real Gap in LiDAR-Based ITS Perception》（IEEE T-ITS，2026）。

使用该流程生成的合成激光雷达数据集发布于《UrbanTwin: Synthetic Roadside LiDAR Datasets》（IEEE OJ-ITS，2026），可在Harvard Dataverse下载。每个数据集包含10K帧，涵盖六个目标类别的标注，用于检测、跟踪和分割任务，并与此处使用的多类别评估直接兼容；论文中的实证分析包括分布真实感指标和单类别3D目标检测研究作为概念验证。对于端到端激光雷达处理，我们还提供LiGuard框架（IEEE T-IV，2026）

pages.title: Evaluation
pages.content:
Evaluation Protocol

Two scores are computed and combined into a single Combined score that determines leaderboard rank.

1. Distributional realism

Aggregation:

  1. Concatenate the 50 submitted synthetic frames into one set S_syn; concatenate the 50 held-out real reference frames into S_real.
  2. Mask both to the point-cloud range [-40, -40, -8, 40, 40, 2].
  3. Subsample uniformly at random to N = 10,000 points per side, with seed 1234 (identical seed used by the local evaluator in the starter kit).
  4. Compute one CD, MMD, EMD, and FPD across the entire 10,000-point sets.

1a. Chamfer Distance (CD)

CD(P, Q) = (1/|P|) Σ_{p ∈ P} min_{q ∈ Q} ||p - q||²
         + (1/|Q|) Σ_{q ∈ Q} min_{p ∈ P} ||p - q||²

Squared-L2 nearest-neighbor cost; symmetric. Lower is better.

1b. Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD)

MMD²(X, Y) = E[k(x, x')] + E[k(y, y')] - 2 E[k(x, y)],   k(a, b) = exp(-γ ||a - b||²)

Unbiased estimator (off-diagonal). Bandwidth γ is set by the median heuristic on a 1 000-point joint subsample (γ = 1 / (2 · median ||x - y||²)) so the kernel does not saturate at LiDAR spatial scales. Lower is better.

1c. Earth Mover's Distance (EMD)

EMD(X, Y) = √ ( min_{T ∈ Π(X, Y)} Σ_{i,j} T_{ij} · ||x_i - y_j|| )

Wasserstein-1 with Euclidean ground cost, solved exactly by the network simplex (POT's ot.emd2). Reported in metres. Lower is better.

1d. Fréchet Point-cloud Distance (FPD)

FPD = ||μ_X - μ_Y||² + Tr(Σ_X + Σ_Y - 2 (Σ_X · Σ_Y)^{1/2})

FID-style: fits a 3-variate Gaussian to each set's points, computes the 2-Wasserstein between Gaussians. Lower is better.

2. 3D Object Detection

Participants submit detections (predictions.json) on 50 real LiDAR frames whose ground truth is held out. We compute average precision over the 3 object categories defined for this track (vehicle, pedestrian, truck), at IoU thresholds 0.5 (primary) and 0.7 (secondary). Per-class AP is reported, and mean AP across classes (mAP) is the leaderboard's detection score; classes with zero ground-truth instances in the held-out set are excluded from the mean. Both KITTI 11-point and 40-point interpolated AP are reported; the 40-point form is the leaderboard primary.

Ground-truth and predicted boxes use the OpenPCDet 7-DoF format [x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading]. IoU is computed as 3D intersection-over-union between two oriented BEV rectangles times the Z overlap. The KITTI truncation/occlusion/min-height difficulty filter is not applied because those depend on 2D bounding-box annotations that are not natural for roadside LiDAR datasets.

The valid class strings for this track are listed in config.json (shipped in reference_data/) and in submission_format.md in the starter kit. Any prediction with an unrecognized class label is discarded.

3. Combined score

Each component is min-max normalized into [0, 1] using a per-track normalization range:

score_realism   = mean( norm(CD), norm(MMD), norm(EMD), norm(FPD) )    (lower-is-better → 1 - clip)
score_detection = norm( AP_3d @ IoU 0.5 )                               (higher-is-better → clip)
score_combined  = 0.6 · score_detection + 0.4 · score_realism

Normalization endpoints are public in config.json (shipped in reference_data/), so the local evaluator and the server compute identical scores.

Reproducibility

  • Realism is dataset-level — frame ordering does not matter. Submit the 50 synthetic frames in any consistent naming.
  • Subsampling RNG seed: 1234 (same on server and starting kit).
  • The exact scoring program shipped to the Codabench worker is included in the starting kit.
pages.content_zh:
评估协议

计算两个分数并合并为单一的综合分数，以决定排行榜排名。

1. 分布真实性

聚合：

  1. 将50帧提交的合成帧拼接为一个集合S_syn；将50帧留出的真实参考帧拼接为S_real。
  2. 将两者掩膜至点云范围[-40, -40, -8, 40, 40, 2]。
  3. 使用随机均匀子采样，每侧N = 10,000个点，随机种子为1234（与入门套件中本地评估器使用的种子相同）。
  4. 在整个10,000点集合上计算一个CD、MMD、EMD和FPD。

1a. 倒角距离（CD）

CD(P, Q) = (1/|P|) Σ_{p ∈ P} min_{q ∈ Q} ||p - q||²
         + (1/|Q|) Σ_{q ∈ Q} min_{p ∈ P} ||p - q||²

平方L2最近邻代价；对称。越低越好。

1b. 最大均值差异（MMD）

MMD²(X, Y) = E[k(x, x')] + E[k(y, y')] - 2 E[k(x, y)],   k(a, b) = exp(-γ ||a - b||²)

无偏估计量（非对角线）。带宽γ通过在1,000点联合子样本上的中位数启发式设置（γ = 1 / (2 · median ||x - y||²)），以确保核函数在LiDAR空间尺度上不饱和。越低越好。

1c. 推土机距离（EMD）

EMD(X, Y) = √ ( min_{T ∈ Π(X, Y)} Σ_{i,j} T_{ij} · ||x_i - y_j|| )

具有欧几里得地面代价的Wasserstein-1距离，通过网络单纯形法（POT的ot.emd2）精确求解。以米为单位报告。越低越好。

1d. 弗雷歇点云距离（FPD）

FPD = ||μ_X - μ_Y||² + Tr(Σ_X + Σ_Y - 2 (Σ_X · Σ_Y)^{1/2})

FID风格：将三变量高斯分布拟合到每个集合的点，计算高斯分布之间的2-Wasserstein距离。越低越好。

2. 3D目标检测

参与者提交在50帧真实LiDAR帧上的检测结果（predictions.json），这些帧的真实标注被保留。我们在本赛道定义的3个目标类别（车辆、行人、卡车）上计算平均精度，IoU阈值分别为0.5（主要）和0.7（次要）。报告每类AP，跨类别平均AP（mAP）作为排行榜的检测分数；在留出集中真实实例为零的类别不参与平均。同时报告KITTI 11点和40点插值AP；40点形式为排行榜主要指标。

真实标注和预测框使用OpenPCDet 7自由度格式[x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading]。IoU计算为两个定向BEV矩形之间的3D交并比乘以Z轴重叠率。不应用KITTI截断/遮挡/最小高度难度过滤，因为这些依赖于2D边界框标注，而这对于路边LiDAR数据集并不自然。

本赛道有效的类别字符串列于config.json（随reference_data/提供）和入门套件中的submission_format.md。任何具有无法识别类别标签的预测将被丢弃。

3. 综合分数

每个组件使用每个赛道的归一化范围进行最小-最大归一化至[0, 1]：

score_realism   = mean( norm(CD), norm(MMD), norm(EMD), norm(FPD) )    （越低越好 → 1 - clip）
score_detection = norm( AP_3d @ IoU 0.5 )                               （越高越好 → clip）
score_combined  = 0.6 · score_detection + 0.4 · score_realism

归一化端点公开于config.json（随reference_data/提供），因此本地评估器和服务器计算相同的分数。

pages.title: Data
pages.content:
Data

V2X-Real

Real V2X-Real data is publicly available from its original release. We do not redistribute it. Participants must obtain the real dataset directly from its source under its own license.

  • Source: https://github.com/ucla-mobility/V2X-Real
  • License: see the source.

Released for participants

The starting kit (Files tab → starting_kit) contains:

  • detection_test_frames/ — 50 real LiDAR frames (point clouds only, no labels) on which you must run your detector and submit predictions.
  • detection_test_frame_ids.json — the canonical list of frame IDs your predictions.json must cover, in order.
  • forbidden_frames.txt — 100 frame IDs you may not train, validate, or hyperparameter-tune on. This is the union of the 50 detection-test frames and the 50 realism-reference frames. Honor system, enforced by signed declaration in your submission.
  • local_eval.py — the exact scoring program shipped to the Codabench worker. Run it locally to reproduce server scores bit-for-bit, given a dummy reference set you generate from the released detection-test frames.
  • make_dummy_submission.py — produces a known-bad submission that exercises the format. Useful for sanity-checking your pipeline.
  • submission_format.md — full submission spec.

Held out (organizer-only)

  • 50 real frames used as the realism reference set.
  • Ground-truth boxes for the 50 detection-test frames.

Categories evaluated

This track is scored on 3 object categories defined for the V2X-Real dataset: vehicle, pedestrian, truck. The leaderboard's detection score is the mean AP across these categories; classes with zero ground-truth instances in the held-out 50-frame set are excluded from the mean.

Splits

Splits are stratified random samples with fixed seed 1234. The exact frame ID lists are published in the starting kit so anyone can reproduce them from the released real dataset.

Reference baselines

The numbers below are reported for the Car class only, taken from prior work on this dataset. The leaderboard's detection score is the mean AP across all categories defined for this track (see Evaluation), so submissions are scored on broader coverage than these single-class references. The baselines are included to demonstrate that sim → real transfer is achievable on this benchmark and to provide a per-class reference point for orientation while you iterate.

SystemCar 3D AP @ 0.5Car 3D AP @ 0.7
V2X-Real no-fusion benchmark (SECOND, real) 0.3556 n/r
SECOND (UT-V2X-Real synthetic → V2X-Real-IC, IEEE T-ITS 2026) 0.6318 n/r
pages.content_zh:
数据

V2X-Real

真实V2X-Real数据自其原始发布起即公开可用。我们不再重新分发。参赛者必须直接从数据源处获取真实数据集，并遵守其自有许可。

  • 来源： https://github.com/ucla-mobility/V2X-Real
  • 许可： 参见数据源。

向参赛者发布的文件

启动工具包（文件标签页 → starting_kit）包含：

  • detection_test_frames/ — 50帧真实激光雷达数据 （仅包含点云，无标签），您必须在这些数据上运行检测器并提交预测结果。
  • detection_test_frame_ids.json — 您的predictions.json必须涵盖的帧ID标准列表，按此顺序排列。
  • forbidden_frames.txt — 100个不得用于训练、验证或超参数调优的帧ID。这是50个检测测试帧与50个真实性参考帧的并集。基于诚信制度，通过提交时的签署声明强制执行。
  • local_eval.py — 部署至Codabench工作节点的精确评分程序。在本地运行可逐位复现服务器评分，前提是您使用发布的检测测试帧生成虚拟参考集。
  • make_dummy_submission.py — 生成一个已知错误的提交以测试格式。可用于对您的流程进行合理性检查。
  • submission_format.md — 完整提交规范。

保留数据（仅组织者可见）

  • 50帧用作真实性参考集的真实数据。
  • 50个检测测试帧的真值框。

评估类别

本赛道基于为V2X-Real数据集定义的3个目标类别进行评分： 车辆、行人、卡车。排行榜的检测分数为这些类别的平均AP；在保留的50帧数据集中真值实例数为零的类别不纳入平均值计算。

数据划分

划分采用固定随机种子1234的分层随机抽样。精确的帧ID列表已发布在启动工具包中，任何人都可以从发布的真实数据集中复现这些划分。

参考基线

以下数值仅针对车辆类别报告，引用自此数据集上的已有研究。排行榜的检测分数为本赛道定义的所有类别的平均AP（参见评估部分），因此提交作品将在比这些单类别参考更广的覆盖范围上评分。纳入这些基线是为了证明在此基准上仿真到真实的迁移是可行的，并在您迭代过程中提供逐类别的参考点。

pages.title: Submission
pages.content:
Submission Format

Pack everything below into a single submission.zip and upload it on the Submit tab.

submission.zip
├── synthetic/
│   ├── 0001.bin
│   ├── 0002.bin
│   ├── ...
│   └── 0050.bin           # exactly 50 files
├── predictions.json
└── declaration.pdf        # signed honor declaration (PDF). declaration.txt also accepted.

synthetic/<id>.bin

  • Exactly 50 files.
  • Each file is raw float32, shape N × 3, in row-major order, with channels (x, y, z) in metres.
  • Either N × 3 or N × 4 (xyz + intensity) is accepted; the intensity column, if present, is dropped before scoring.
  • Each file ≤ 1.5 MB on disk (~125,000 points). Realism is computed at the dataset level: all 50 frames are concatenated, masked to the track's point-cloud range, then subsampled to 10,000 points (seed 1234) before computing CD / MMD / EMD / FPD. Submitting denser frames does not improve scores; frame ordering does not matter.
  • The simplest valid naming is 0001.bin … 0050.bin.

predictions.json

JSON object whose keys are the frame IDs from detection_test_frame_ids.json (in the starting kit). For every frame ID you must include an entry, even if the value is an empty list.

{
  "<frame_id_1>": [
    {"box": [x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading], "score": 0.97, "class": "vehicle"},
    {"box": [...],                          "score": 0.81, "class": "pedestrian"}
  ],
  "<frame_id_2>": [],
  ...
}
  • box: 7 floats, OpenPCDet convention. (x, y, z) is the box center in metres in the LiDAR frame, (dx, dy, dz) are full extents along the box-local axes, heading is rotation around +Z in radians.
  • score: confidence in [0, 1].
  • class: one of the valid class strings for this track. Valid values: vehicle, pedestrian, truck. Class strings are matched case-insensitively. Predictions with unrecognized class strings are discarded before AP is computed.

declaration.pdf (or declaration.txt)

The starter kit ships declaration_template.pdf, a one-page form with the required honor statement preprinted and a signature line. Fill in team name and date, sign (digitally with any PDF tool, or print → sign → scan), save as declaration.pdf, and include it in every submission.

If you cannot easily produce a signed PDF, a plain declaration.txt is also accepted. Required statement (verbatim, case-insensitive):

I confirm that I did not train on any frame listed in forbidden_frames.txt, and that all submitted detections were produced by a model trained only on synthetic data I generated.

What gets returned

After scoring (typically < 5 minutes for valid submissions) you'll see your position on the leaderboard plus a Detailed Results view with all component metrics, including per-class AP.
pages.content_zh:
提交格式

将所有以下内容打包到一个 submission.zip 文件中，并在提交标签页上传。

submission.zip
├── synthetic/
│   ├── 0001.bin
│   ├── 0002.bin
│   ├── ...
│   └── 0050.bin           # 恰好 50 个文件
├── predictions.json
└── declaration.pdf        # 签署的诚信声明（PDF）。也接受 declaration.txt。

synthetic/<id>.bin

  • 恰好 50 个文件。
  • 每个文件为原始 float32 格式，形状为 N × 3，按行优先顺序排列，通道为 (x, y, z)，单位为米。
  • 接受 N × 3 或 N × 4（xyz + 强度）格式；如果存在强度列，将在评分前被丢弃。
  • 每个文件在磁盘上不超过 1.5 MB（约 125,000 个点）。真实感在数据集层面计算：所有 50 帧被拼接，根据赛道的点云范围进行掩码处理，然后下采样至 10,000 个点（随机种子 1234），再计算 CD / MMD / EMD / FPD。提交更密集的帧不会提高分数；帧顺序无关紧要。
  • 最简单的有效命名方式为 0001.bin … 0050.bin。

predictions.json

JSON 对象的键为 detection_test_frame_ids.json（在起始套件中）中的帧 ID。对于每个帧 ID，您都必须包含一个条目，即使该值为空列表。

{
  "<frame_id_1>": [
    {"box": [x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading], "score": 0.97, "class": "vehicle"},
    {"box": [...],                          "score": 0.81, "class": "pedestrian"}
  ],
  "<frame_id_2>": [],
  ...
}
  • box：7 个浮点数，遵循 OpenPCDet 约定。(x, y, z) 是 LiDAR 坐标系中包围框中心的坐标（单位：米），(dx, dy, dz) 是沿包围框局部坐标轴的全尺寸，heading 是绕 +Z 轴的旋转角度（单位：弧度）。
  • score：置信度，范围为 [0, 1]。
  • class：该赛道的有效类别字符串之一。有效值：vehicle、pedestrian、truck。类别字符串匹配时不区分大小写。在计算 AP 之前，类别字符串无法识别的预测将被丢弃。

declaration.pdf（或 declaration.txt）

起始套件包含 declaration_template.pdf，这是一份单页表格，预先印有所需的诚信声明和签名栏。填写团队名称和日期，签名（使用任意 PDF 工具进行数字签名，或打印 → 签名 → 扫描），保存为 declaration.pdf，并包含在每次提交中。

如果您无法方便地生成签名 PDF，也接受纯文本 declaration.txt。所需声明（逐字，不区分大小写）：

我确认我未使用 forbidden_frames.txt 中列出的任何帧进行训练，且所有提交的检测结果均由仅使用我生成的合成数据训练的模型产生。

返回结果

评分后（有效提交通常少于 5 分钟），您将看到自己在排行榜上的位置，以及包含所有组件指标（包括每类 AP）的详细结果视图。

pages.title: Rules
pages.content:
Rules

Eligibility

  • Open to anyone — researchers, students, industry teams.
  • Each team must register one participant account; do not maintain multiple accounts.

Allowed

  • Any simulation framework or generative model (CARLA, Helios++, OpenScene, neural radiance fields, diffusion, GANs, custom physics). Open or closed source — what matters is the synthesized data.
  • Any 3D object detector architecture, trained on your synthetic data only.
  • Augmentations applied during detector training (rotation, scale, flip, ground-truth sampling, noise) — they operate on synthetic data, not on the forbidden real frames.
  • Using the train split of the public real dataset for hyperparameter selection or domain adaptation, provided no forbidden frame is touched. (The forbidden list contains only the 100 reserved frames, not the entire real train split.)

Forbidden

  • Training, validating, hyperparameter-tuning, or otherwise observing ground truth from any of the 100 frames listed in forbidden_frames.txt. This is enforced by signed declaration and is the foundational integrity rule of the challenge.
  • Submitting predictions produced by a model that has been trained on real labels for any roadside-LiDAR dataset. The detector must be sim-only.
  • Reverse-engineering or inferring the held-out realism reference frames via Codabench's leaderboard signal (e.g., probing submissions designed to leak the reference set's identity). Submissions found to be doing this will be disqualified.
  • Multiple accounts, sub-team accounts, or coordinating across registered teams.

Disqualification

Organizers reserve the right to inspect the synthetic frames and predictions of any submission for evidence of forbidden-frame leakage (e.g., synthetic frames that suspiciously resemble held-out real frames; predictions whose distribution implies access to held-out ground truth). Disqualified participants are removed from the leaderboard and from prize consideration.

Prizes

Per track: 1st place USD 500, 2nd place USD 300, 3rd place USD 200. Sponsor(s) will be announced before the Development phase opens.

Publication and credit

  • Every participating team submits a 4–8 page challenge report describing their approach, due by the final-phase deadline (November 15, 2026).
  • Teams that prefer not to publish may opt into the non-publication track for their submission.
  • Top-3 teams per track are invited to present at the IEEE BigData 2026 Big Data Cup workshop session in Phoenix, AZ (December 14–17, 2026), and to submit a full paper to the IEEE BigData 2026 proceedings through the challenge's associated paper track.
  • The challenge organizers may publish an aggregate analysis of all submissions (anonymized unless explicit permission is granted).

pages.content:
UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge — LUMPI Track

Update —Codabench was down roughly from Oct 21, 2026 to Oct 26, 2026. To compensate for that, the deadline for Development Phase (that now allows a max of 10 submissions per day) and Letters of Intent (LoI) has been extended to November 5, 2026, 11:59 PM EST (November 6, 2026, 04:59 UTC). If you have not already submitted LoI please use this link: Letter of Intent Form.

Update — Due to increased interest from multiple qualified participants, Letters of Intent are now accepted through October 30, 2026, 8:00 PM EDT, aligned with the close of the development phase. Teams that have already submitted an LOI by email need take no further action. Teams joining now can register via our Letter of Intent Form.

Update — the Letter of Intent deadline is extended to August 15, 2026 (previously July 25). All other dates are unchanged.

A track of the 2026 IEEE Big Data Cup, held in conjunction with the IEEE International Conference on Big Data (IEEE BigData) 2026, Phoenix, AZ, USA.

Roadside LiDAR perception for intelligent transportation systems is bottlenecked by the cost and rarity of large, well-annotated real datasets. This challenge asks: can synthetic LiDAR data be made realistic enough that a deep learning model trained on it generalizes to real LiDAR frames?

Towards that, this challenge asks participants to generate their own synthetic LiDAR data targeting the LUMPI distribution, train an object detector on that data, and submit detections on real held-out frames. We score on (1) how distributionally close their synthetic frames are to real ones, and (2) how well the sim-only detector performs on real frames.

Important Dates

  • Letter of Intent Deadline: August 15, 2026 (extended from July 25)
  • Final Report and Solution Submission Deadline: November 15, 2026
  • Winning Teams Announcement: November 25, 2026
  • Conference: December 14–17, 2026

Reference resources for participants

To support participants who would like a documented starting point, we make publicly available a complete reference pipeline covering synthesis methodology, empirical analysis, ready-to-use synthetic datasets, and an open-source LiDAR data processing and visualization software. These materials are offered as orientation, not as requirements.

The synthesis pipeline is described in UrbanTwin: Building High-Fidelity Digital Twins for Sim2Real LiDAR Perception and Evaluation (arXiv preprint), with a deeper empirical analysis including the distributional realism metrics adopted by this challenge in High-Fidelity Digital Twins for Bridging the Sim2Real Gap in LiDAR-Based ITS Perception (IEEE T-ITS, 2026).

The synthetic LiDAR datasets generated with that pipeline are released in UrbanTwin: Synthetic Roadside LiDAR Datasets (IEEE OJ-ITS, 2026) and are available for download at Harvard Dataverse. Each dataset contains 10K frames annotated across six object categories for detection, tracking, and segmentation tasks, and is directly compatible with the multi-class evaluation used here; empirical analysis in papers include both the distributional realism metrics and single-class 3D object detection study as proof-of-concept. For end-to-end LiDAR processing we also provide our LiGuard Framework (IEEE T-IV, 2026) with short, more software focused read on The Journal of Open Source Software.

What you will do

  1. Download the public real LUMPI dataset and the released detection-test point clouds (50 real frames, no labels).
  2. Generate synthetic LiDAR frames using any approach you like — simulation (CARLA, LGSVL, custom), generative models (diffusion, GANs, flow-based), hybrid pipelines, or anything else.
  3. Train a 3D object detector (any architecture) on only your synthetic data.
  4. Submit:
    • 50 of your synthetic LiDAR frames,
    • your detector's predictions on the 50 released test point clouds,
    • and a signed honor declaration.

Scoring at a glance

Combined score = 0.6 × normalized 3D mAP + 0.4 × normalized realism, where 3D mAP is averaged across the 8 object categories defined for this track (Person, Car, Bicycle, Motorcycle, Bus, Truck, Van, Unknown) and realism averages normalized Chamfer Distance, MMD, EMD, and Fréchet Point-cloud Distance. See the Evaluation tab for the formulae.

Prizes

Per track:

  • 1st place: USD 500
  • 2nd place: USD 300
  • 3rd place: USD 200

Sponsor(s) will be announced before the Development phase opens.

Phases

  • Development — public leaderboard, up to 5 submissions/day per participant, 100 total. Use this to iterate.
  • Final — private leaderboard until close, 5 total submissions per participant. The final-phase ranking determines the winners.

Baselines

Reference numbers are listed in the Data tab.

pages.title: Evaluation
pages.content:
Evaluation Protocol

Two scores are computed and combined into a single Combined score that determines leaderboard rank.

1. Distributional realism

Aggregation:

  1. Concatenate the 50 submitted synthetic frames into one set S_syn; concatenate the 50 held-out real reference frames into S_real.
  2. Mask both to the point-cloud range [-40, -40, -5, 40, 40, 5].
  3. Subsample uniformly at random to N = 10,000 points per side, with seed 1234 (identical seed used by the local evaluator in the starter kit).
  4. Compute one CD, MMD, EMD, and FPD across the entire 10,000-point sets.

1a. Chamfer Distance (CD)

CD(P, Q) = (1/|P|) Σ_{p ∈ P} min_{q ∈ Q} ||p - q||²
         + (1/|Q|) Σ_{q ∈ Q} min_{p ∈ P} ||p - q||²

Squared-L2 nearest-neighbor cost; symmetric. Lower is better.

1b. Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD)

MMD²(X, Y) = E[k(x, x')] + E[k(y, y')] - 2 E[k(x, y)],   k(a, b) = exp(-γ ||a - b||²)

Unbiased estimator (off-diagonal). Bandwidth γ is set by the median heuristic on a 1 000-point joint subsample (γ = 1 / (2 · median ||x - y||²)) so the kernel does not saturate at LiDAR spatial scales. Lower is better.

1c. Earth Mover's Distance (EMD)

EMD(X, Y) = √ ( min_{T ∈ Π(X, Y)} Σ_{i,j} T_{ij} · ||x_i - y_j|| )

Wasserstein-1 with Euclidean ground cost, solved exactly by the network simplex (POT's ot.emd2). Reported in metres. Lower is better.

1d. Fréchet Point-cloud Distance (FPD)

FPD = ||μ_X - μ_Y||² + Tr(Σ_X + Σ_Y - 2 (Σ_X · Σ_Y)^{1/2})

FID-style: fits a 3-variate Gaussian to each set's points, computes the 2-Wasserstein between Gaussians. Lower is better.

2. 3D Object Detection

Participants submit detections (predictions.json) on 50 real LiDAR frames whose ground truth is held out. We compute average precision over the 8 object categories defined for this track (Person, Car, Bicycle, Motorcycle, Bus, Truck, Van, Unknown), at IoU thresholds 0.5 (primary) and 0.7 (secondary). Per-class AP is reported, and mean AP across classes (mAP) is the leaderboard's detection score; classes with zero ground-truth instances in the held-out set are excluded from the mean. Both KITTI 11-point and 40-point interpolated AP are reported; the 40-point form is the leaderboard primary.

Ground-truth and predicted boxes use the OpenPCDet 7-DoF format [x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading]. IoU is computed as 3D intersection-over-union between two oriented BEV rectangles times the Z overlap. The KITTI truncation/occlusion/min-height difficulty filter is not applied because those depend on 2D bounding-box annotations that are not natural for roadside LiDAR datasets.

The valid class strings for this track are listed in config.json (shipped in reference_data/) and in submission_format.md in the starter kit. Any prediction with an unrecognized class label is discarded.

3. Combined score

Each component is min-max normalized into [0, 1] using a per-track normalization range:

score_realism   = mean( norm(CD), norm(MMD), norm(EMD), norm(FPD) )    (lower-is-better → 1 - clip)
score_detection = norm( AP_3d @ IoU 0.5 )                               (higher-is-better → clip)
score_combined  = 0.6 · score_detection + 0.4 · score_realism

Normalization endpoints are public in config.json (shipped in reference_data/), so the local evaluator and the server compute identical scores.

Reproducibility

  • Realism is dataset-level — frame ordering does not matter. Submit the 50 synthetic frames in any consistent naming.
  • Subsampling RNG seed: 1234 (same on server and starting kit).
  • The exact scoring program shipped to the Codabench worker is included in the starting kit.
pages.content_zh:
评估协议

计算两个分数并合并为一个综合分数，该分数决定排行榜排名。

1. 分布真实性

聚合：

  1. 将50个提交的合成帧拼接为一个集合S_syn；将50个留出的真实参考帧拼接为S_real。
  2. 将两者裁剪至点云范围[-40, -40, -5, 40, 40, 5]。
  3. 使用随机种子1234（与入门套件中本地评估器使用的种子相同），在每侧均匀随机子采样至N = 10,000个点。
  4. 在整个10,000点集合上计算一个CD、MMD、EMD和FPD。

1a. Chamfer距离（CD）

CD(P, Q) = (1/|P|) Σ_{p ∈ P} min_{q ∈ Q} ||p - q||²
         + (1/|Q|) Σ_{q ∈ Q} min_{p ∈ P} ||p - q||²

平方L2最近邻代价；对称。越低越好。

1b. 最大均值差异（MMD）

MMD²(X, Y) = E[k(x, x')] + E[k(y, y')] - 2 E[k(x, y)],   k(a, b) = exp(-γ ||a - b||²)

无偏估计量（非对角线）。带宽γ通过1,000点联合子样本的中位数启发式方法设置（γ = 1 / (2 · 中位数 ||x - y||²)），以使核函数在激光雷达空间尺度上不会饱和。越低越好。

1c. 推土机距离（EMD）

EMD(X, Y) = √ ( min_{T ∈ Π(X, Y)} Σ_{i,j} T_{ij} · ||x_i - y_j|| )

使用欧几里得地面成本的Wasserstein-1距离，通过网络单纯形法（POT的ot.emd2）精确求解。以米为单位报告。越低越好。

1d. Fréchet点云距离（FPD）

FPD = ||μ_X - μ_Y||²

pages.title: Data
pages.content:
Data

LUMPI

Real LUMPI data is publicly available from its original release. We do not redistribute it. Participants must obtain the real dataset directly from its source under its own license.

  • Source: https://data.uni-hannover.de/dataset/lumpi
  • License: see the source.

Released for participants

The starting kit (Files tab → starting_kit) contains:

  • detection_test_frames/ — 50 real LiDAR frames (point clouds only, no labels) on which you must run your detector and submit predictions.
  • detection_test_frame_ids.json — the canonical list of frame IDs your predictions.json must cover, in order.
  • forbidden_frames.txt — 100 frame IDs you may not train, validate, or hyperparameter-tune on. This is the union of the 50 detection-test frames and the 50 realism-reference frames. Honor system, enforced by signed declaration in your submission.
  • local_eval.py — the exact scoring program shipped to the Codabench worker. Run it locally to reproduce server scores bit-for-bit, given a dummy reference set you generate from the released detection-test frames.
  • make_dummy_submission.py — produces a known-bad submission that exercises the format. Useful for sanity-checking your pipeline.
  • submission_format.md — full submission spec.

Held out (organizer-only)

  • 50 real frames used as the realism reference set.
  • Ground-truth boxes for the 50 detection-test frames.

Categories evaluated

This track is scored on 8 object categories defined for the LUMPI dataset: Person, Car, Bicycle, Motorcycle, Bus, Truck, Van, Unknown. The leaderboard's detection score is the mean AP across these categories; classes with zero ground-truth instances in the held-out 50-frame set are excluded from the mean.

Splits

Splits are stratified random samples with fixed seed 1234. The exact frame ID lists are published in the starting kit so anyone can reproduce them from the released real dataset.

Reference baselines

The numbers below are reported for the Car class only, taken from prior work on this dataset. The leaderboard's detection score is the mean AP across all categories defined for this track (see Evaluation), so submissions are scored on broader coverage than these single-class references. The baselines are included to demonstrate that sim → real transfer is achievable on this benchmark and to provide a per-class reference point for orientation while you iterate.

SystemCar 3D AP @ 0.5Car 3D AP @ 0.7
SEED (real LUMPI training, IEEE T-ITS 2026) 0.4270 n/r
SEED (UT-LUMPI synthetic → real LUMPI, IEEE T-ITS 2026) 0.4474 n/r

LUMPI

真实LUMPI数据自其最初发布以来即可公开获取。我们不再重新分发。参与者必须在其自有许可下直接从数据源获取真实数据集。

  • 来源： https://data.uni-hannover.de/dataset/lumpi
  • 许可协议： 见数据源。

向参与者发布的内容

起步套件（Files标签页 → starting_kit）包含：

  • detection_test_frames/ —— 50帧真实激光雷达数据（仅点云，无标注），您必须在其上运行检测器并提交预测结果。
  • detection_test_frame_ids.json —— 您的predictions.json必须按顺序覆盖的帧ID规范列表。
  • forbidden_frames.txt —— 100个禁止用于训练、验证或超参数调优的帧ID。这是50个检测测试帧与50个真实度参考帧的并集。基于诚信制度，通过您提交时的签字声明强制执行。
  • local_eval.py —— 发送至Codabench工作节点的精确评分程序。在本地运行它以逐位复现服务器评分，前提是您从发布的检测测试帧生成一个虚拟参考集。
  • make_dummy_submission.py —— 生成一个已知错误的提交，用于测试格式。有助于对您的流程进行合理性检查。
  • submission_format.md —— 完整的提交规范。

保留数据（仅组织者可访问）

  • 50帧用作真实度参考集的真实数据。
  • 50个检测测试帧的真值框。

评估类别

本赛道对LUMPI数据集定义的8个目标类别进行评分：行人、轿车、自行车、摩托车、公交车、卡车、面包车、未知。排行榜的检测分数为这些类别的平均精度（AP）均值；在保留的50帧数据集中真值实例为零的类别不参与均值计算。

数据划分

数据划分为使用固定随机种子1234的分层随机抽样。确切的帧ID列表公布在起步套件中，以便任何人都能从发布的真实数据集中复现这些划分。

pages.title: Submission
pages.content:
Submission Format

Pack everything below into a single submission.zip and upload it on the Submit tab.

submission.zip
├── synthetic/
│   ├── 0001.bin
│   ├── 0002.bin
│   ├── ...
│   └── 0050.bin           # exactly 50 files
├── predictions.json
└── declaration.pdf        # signed honor declaration (PDF). declaration.txt also accepted.

synthetic/<id>.bin

  • Exactly 50 files.
  • Each file is raw float32, shape N × 3, in row-major order, with channels (x, y, z) in metres.
  • Either N × 3 or N × 4 (xyz + intensity) is accepted; the intensity column, if present, is dropped before scoring.
  • Each file ≤ 1.5 MB on disk (~125,000 points). Realism is computed at the dataset level: all 50 frames are concatenated, masked to the track's point-cloud range, then subsampled to 10,000 points (seed 1234) before computing CD / MMD / EMD / FPD. Submitting denser frames does not improve scores; frame ordering does not matter.
  • The simplest valid naming is 0001.bin … 0050.bin.

predictions.json

JSON object whose keys are the frame IDs from detection_test_frame_ids.json (in the starting kit). For every frame ID you must include an entry, even if the value is an empty list.

{
  "<frame_id_1>": [
    {"box": [x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading], "score": 0.97, "class": "Car"},
    {"box": [...],                          "score": 0.81, "class": "Person"}
  ],
  "<frame_id_2>": [],
  ...
}
  • box: 7 floats, OpenPCDet convention. (x, y, z) is the box center in metres in the LiDAR frame, (dx, dy, dz) are full extents along the box-local axes, heading is rotation around +Z in radians.
  • score: confidence in [0, 1].
  • class: one of the valid class strings for this track. Valid values: Person, Car, Bicycle, Motorcycle, Bus, Truck, Van, Unknown. Class strings are matched case-insensitively. Predictions with unrecognized class strings are discarded before AP is computed.

declaration.pdf (or declaration.txt)

The starter kit ships declaration_template.pdf, a one-page form with the required honor statement preprinted and a signature line. Fill in team name and date, sign (digitally with any PDF tool, or print → sign → scan), save as declaration.pdf, and include it in every submission.

If you cannot easily produce a signed PDF, a plain declaration.txt is also accepted. Required statement (verbatim, case-insensitive):

I confirm that I did not train on any frame listed in forbidden_frames.txt, and that all submitted detections were produced by a model trained only on synthetic data I generated.

What gets returned

After scoring (typically < 5 minutes for valid submissions) you'll see your position on the leaderboard plus a Detailed Results view with all component metrics, including per-class AP.

提交格式

将以下内容全部打包到一个 submission.zip 文件中，并在提交标签页上传。

submission.zip
├── synthetic/
│   ├── 0001.bin
│   ├── 0002.bin
│   ├── ...
│   └── 0050.bin           # 恰好50个文件
├── predictions.json
└── declaration.pdf        # 签署的诚信声明（PDF）。也接受 declaration.txt。

synthetic/<id>.bin

  • 恰好 50 个文件。
  • 每个文件为原始 float32 格式，形状为 N × 3，行优先顺序，通道为 (x, y, z)，单位为米。
  • 接受 N × 3 或 N × 4（xyz + 强度）格式；如果存在强度列，在评分前会被丢弃。
  • 每个文件磁盘大小 ≤ 1.5 MB（约125,000个点）。真实度在数据集层面计算：所有50帧被拼接，掩码处理至赛道点云范围，然后子采样至10,000个点（随机种子1234），再计算 CD / MMD / EMD / FPD。提交更密集的帧不会提高分数；帧的顺序无关紧要。
  • 最简单的有效命名方式为 0001.bin … 0050.bin。

predictions.json

JSON对象，其键为来自 detection_test_frame_ids.json（在起始工具包中）的帧ID。对于每个帧ID，必须包含一个条目，即使值为空列表。

{
  "<frame_id_1>": [
    {"box": [x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, heading], "score": 0.97, "class": "Car"},
    {"box": [...],                          "score": 0.81, "class": "Person"}
  ],
  "<frame_id_2>": [],
  ...
}
  • box：7个浮点数，OpenPCDet约定。(x, y, z) 为边界框中心在LiDAR坐标系中的位置（单位：米），(dx, dy, dz) 为沿边界框局部轴的完整尺寸，heading 为绕 +Z 轴的旋转角度（弧度）。
  • score：[0, 1] 区间内的置信度。
  • class：此赛道有效的类别字符串之一。 有效值：Person、Car、Bicycle、 Motorcycle、Bus、Truck、 Van、Unknown。类别字符串不区分大小写匹配。包含无法识别类别字符串的预测将在计算AP前被丢弃。

declaration.pdf（或 declaration.txt）

起始工具包中包含 declaration_template.pdf，这是一页预印了所需诚信声明和签名行的表格。填写团队名称和日期，签名（可使用任何PDF工具电子签名，或打印 → 签名 → 扫描），保存为 declaration.pdf，并包含在每次提交中。

如果您无法轻松生成签署的PDF，也接受纯文本 declaration.txt。所需声明（原文照录，不区分大小写）：

I confirm that I did not train on any frame listed in forbidden_frames.txt, and that all submitted detections were produced by a model trained only on synthetic data I generated.

返回内容

评分后（有效提交通常少于5分钟），您将看到自己在排行榜上的位置，以及包含所有分项指标（包括每类AP）的详细结果视图。

pages.title: Rules
pages.content:
Rules

Eligibility

  • Open to anyone — researchers, students, industry teams.
  • Each team must register one participant account; do not maintain multiple accounts.

Allowed

  • Any simulation framework or generative model (CARLA, Helios++, OpenScene, neural radiance fields, diffusion, GANs, custom physics). Open or closed source — what matters is the synthesized data.
  • Any 3D object detector architecture, trained on your synthetic data only.
  • Augmentations applied during detector training (rotation, scale, flip, ground-truth sampling, noise) — they operate on synthetic data, not on the forbidden real frames.
  • Using the train split of the public real dataset for hyperparameter selection or domain adaptation, provided no forbidden frame is touched. (The forbidden list contains only the 100 reserved frames, not the entire real train split.)

Forbidden

  • Training, validating, hyperparameter-tuning, or otherwise observing ground truth from any of the 100 frames listed in forbidden_frames.txt. This is enforced by signed declaration and is the foundational integrity rule of the challenge.
  • Submitting predictions produced by a model that has been trained on real labels for any roadside-LiDAR dataset. The detector must be sim-only.
  • Reverse-engineering or inferring the held-out realism reference frames via Codabench's leaderboard signal (e.g., probing submissions designed to leak the reference set's identity). Submissions found to be doing this will be disqualified.
  • Multiple accounts, sub-team accounts, or coordinating across registered teams.

Disqualification

Organizers reserve the right to inspect the synthetic frames and predictions of any submission for evidence of forbidden-frame leakage (e.g., synthetic frames that suspiciously resemble held-out real frames; predictions whose distribution implies access to held-out ground truth). Disqualified participants are removed from the leaderboard and from prize consideration.

Prizes

Per track: 1st place USD 500, 2nd place USD 300, 3rd place USD 200. Sponsor(s) will be announced before the Development phase opens.

Publication and credit

  • Every participating team submits a 4–8 page challenge report describing their approach, due by the final-phase deadline (November 15, 2026).
  • Teams that prefer not to publish may opt into the non-publication track for their submission.
  • Top-3 teams per track are invited to present at the IEEE BigData 2026 Big Data Cup workshop session in Phoenix, AZ (December 14–17, 2026), and to submit a full paper to the IEEE BigData 2026 proceedings through the challenge's associated paper track.
  • The challenge organizers may publish an aggregate analysis of all submissions (anonymized unless explicit permission is granted).

规则

参赛资格

  • 面向所有人员开放 — 研究人员、学生、行业团队。
  • 每支团队必须注册一个参赛账号；请勿维护多个账号。

允许事项

  • 任何模拟框架或生成模型（CARLA、Helios++、OpenScene、神经辐射场、扩散模型、生成对抗网络、自定义物理引擎）。开源或闭源均可 — 关键在于合成数据。
  • 任何3D目标检测器架构，但必须仅在您的合成数据上进行训练。
  • 检测器训练期间应用的数据增强（旋转、缩放、翻转、真值采样、噪声）— 这些操作针对合成数据，而非禁止使用的真实帧。
  • 使用公开真实数据集的训练集进行超参数选择或域适应，前提是未接触任何禁止帧。（禁止列表仅包含100个保留帧，而非整个真实训练集。）

禁止事项

  • 对forbidden_frames.txt中列出的100个帧中的任何一帧进行训练、验证、超参数调优，或以其他方式观察其真值。这通过签署声明强制执行，是本挑战赛的基础诚信规则。
  • 提交由曾在任何路边激光雷达数据集的真实标签上训练过的模型生成的预测结果。检测器必须仅使用模拟数据。
  • 通过Codabench排行榜信号逆向工程或推断被保留的真实参考帧（例如，设计用于泄露参考集身份的探测性提交）。发现此类行为的提交将被取消资格。
  • 拥有多个账号、子团队账号，或在已注册团队之间进行协调。

取消资格

组织者保留检查任何提交作品的合成帧和预测结果的权利，以查找禁止帧泄露的证据（例如，与保留真实帧高度相似的合成帧；其分布暗示接触过保留真值的预测结果）。被取消资格的参与者将从排行榜和奖项评选中移除。

奖项

每条赛道：第一名500美元，第二名300美元，第三名200美元。赞助方将在开发阶段开始前公布。

发表与署名

  • 每个参赛团队需提交一份4–8页的竞赛报告，描述其方法，截止日期为最终阶段截止日期（2026年11月15日）。
  • 不愿发表的团队可以选择将其提交纳入不发表赛道。
  • 每条赛道的前三名团队将获邀在IEEE BigData 2026大数据杯研讨会（2026年12月14日至17日，亚利桑那州凤凰城）上进行展示，并可通过挑战赛关联的论文通道向IEEE BigData 2026会议论文集提交完整论文。
  • 挑战赛组织者可能会发表对所有提交作品的汇总分析（匿名处理，除非获得明确许可）。

pages.content: # Welcome to Track 2: HA-VLN **Human-Aware Vision-and-Language Navigation (HA-VLN)** is Track 2 of [RoboWorld 2026](https://roboworld2026.github.io/), affiliated with the [RoboPAD Workshop at NeurIPS 2026](https://robotpad2026.github.io/). ## Challenge Overview This track challenges participants to develop **human-aware vision-and-language navigation agents** that follow natural-language instructions **safely, efficiently, and socially** in dynamic human environments. While many standard VLN benchmarks assume static scenes, real-world spaces are shared with moving people who serve as both semantic landmarks and dynamic obstacles. Built on [HA-VLN 2.0](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14229), submissions must balance **instruction following** and **social compliance** under partial observability and real-time human interactions. - **Human-Referenced Grounding**: Interpret fine-grained instructions that reference both scene landmarks and ongoing human activities. - **Social Norm Compliance**: Respect personal space, proactively avoid human collisions, and navigate safely around moving bystanders. - **Realistic Benchmarking**: Navigate indoor and outdoor areas with multi-human interactions in the HA-R2R and HAPS 2.0 datasets. We welcome navigation policies, waypoint and topological planners, world models, and VLA approaches that advance safe, human-centered navigation in shared spaces. ## Task Definition - **Input:** A natural-language navigation instruction, initial pose and ongoing agent pose (position and heading from simulator state, GPS+compass), and sequential egocentric forward-facing RGB-D observations. Direct access to ground-truth human trajectories (`human_motion.json`) is strictly prohibited during inference. - **Sensor Setup:** One forward-facing RGB-D camera. Adding additional cameras is not permitted; panoramic views must be acquired by rotating in place (rotation actions count toward the action budget). - **Setting:** **Closed-loop interactive navigation** in continuous 3D environments with dynamic humans. - **Actions:** Six discrete actions: `STOP`, `MOVE_FORWARD`, `TURN_LEFT`, `TURN_RIGHT`, `LOOK_UP`, `LOOK_DOWN`. - **Output:** An ordered sequence of 1 to 500 discrete actions for each episode submitted for official simulator replay. Sequences shorter than 500 actions must end in `STOP`; sequences reaching the 500-action limit may omit `STOP`. - **Objective:** Reach the instructed goal safely while avoiding collisions with humans. ## Phases - **Phase 1 (Validation)**: Development on released `val_seen` (778 episodes) and `val_unseen` (1,839 episodes). Both splits are reported; only the `val_unseen` Score determines the Phase 1 ranking. Phase 1 is open until November 23, 2026 (Monday) solely for development and testing, and does not count towards final challenge rankings or awards. - **Phase 2 (Final Evaluation)**: Evaluation on withheld test scoring data (3,408 test episodes). The test Score determines final rankings and awards. All teams are eligible to participate in Phase 2 regardless of Phase 1 participation. [Download Phase 2 Test Dataset](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HcSg3qCxriEjsgDLlPWBEz9TbgD5RA7W?usp=drive_link). Phase 1 scores do not determine shortlisting or awards and are not combined with Phase 2 scores. Submit at most five times per day and 100 times per phase; the best Score is retained. ## Schedule 1. Registration opens October 08, 2026. 2. Phase 1 opens October 15, 2026, and closes November 23, 2026 (Monday) *(Extended from October 30)*. 3. Phase 2 opens October 30, 2026, and closes November 30, 2026. 4. Award decisions are announced on December 12, 2026. ## Awards & Recognition 1. **Certificates of Recognition**: Official certificates awarded to the Top 5 teams in Track 2. 2. **Best Innovative Solution**: Certificate recognizing outstanding creativity and technical innovation. 3. **Oral Presentations**: Selected top-performing teams will be invited to give oral presentations at the RoboPAD Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Final rankings and awards are determined entirely by Phase 2 final evaluation. ## Materials & Toolkit - [Challenge repository and participant toolkit](https://github.com/roboworld2026/track2): Documentation, data download scripts, baseline setup, and action submission exporter. - [Phase 2 Official Test Dataset (Google Drive)](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HcSg3qCxriEjsgDLlPWBEz9TbgD5RA7W?usp=drive_link): Official test instructions and human annotations for Phase 2 evaluation. - [Track website](https://roboworld2026.github.io/track2): Official track details and announcements. - [HA-VLN 2.0](https://uwmilab.github.io/HA-VLN-webpage/): Project page and [official repository](https://github.com/UWMILab/HA-VLN). - Starting kits: Download the Phase 2 starting kit attached to this competition for the official test episode manifest, example submission, and local validator (the Phase 1 starting kit remains available for validation development). ## Registration Register your team through the [Google Form](https://roboworld2026.github.io/#registration) (registration opens October 08, 2026) to be eligible for the leaderboard, certificates, and awards. ## Contact - **Frequently Asked Questions:** [Track 2 FAQ](https://github.com/roboworld2026/track2#-frequently-asked-questions) (please check the FAQ before emailing for common questions) - **Technical Support:** [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/roboworld2026/track2/issues) - **Contact Email:** [roboworld2026@gmail.com](mailto:roboworld2026@gmail.com) - **Discord:** [Join the RoboWorld Track 2 Discord](https://discord.gg/S8s8JcxtT) - **WeChat Group:** [Join the RoboWorld Track 2 WeChat Group](https://github.com/roboworld2026/roboworld2026.github.io/blob/main/wechat_track2.JPG)
pages.content_zh:
欢迎来到赛道2：HA-VLN

**具人感知视觉语言导航（HA-VLN）**是 [RoboWorld 2026](https://roboworld2026.github.io/) 的赛道2，隶属于 [NeurIPS 2026 RoboPAD研讨会](https://robotpad2026.github.io/)。

## 挑战赛概述

本赛道要求参赛者开发**具人感知视觉语言导航智能体**，使其能够在动态人体环境中**安全、高效且符合社交规范**地遵循自然语言指令。

尽管许多标准VLN基准测试假设场景是静态的，但真实世界空间与移动的人群共享，这些人既是语义地标也是动态障碍物。基于 [HA-VLN 2.0](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14229)，提交作品必须在部分可观测性和实时人体交互的条件下，平衡**指令遵循**与**社交合规性**。

- **人参考接地**：解读同时参考场景地标和正在进行的人体活动的细粒度指令。
- **社会规范遵守**：尊重个人空间，主动避免与人体碰撞，并安全地绕行移动旁观者。
- **真实基准测试**：在HA-R2R和HAPS 2.0数据集中，在具有多人体交互的室内和室外区域进行导航。

我们欢迎导航策略、路点和拓扑规划器、世界模型以及VLA（视觉语言动作）方法，以推动共享空间中安全、以人为中心的导航技术发展。

## 任务定义

- **输入**：自然语言指令和连续的以自我为中心的RGB-D观测。
- **设置**：在具有动态人体的连续3D环境中进行**闭环交互式导航**。
- **动作**：六个离散动作：`停止`、`前进`、`左转`、`右转`、`抬头`、`低头`。
- **输出**：动作的有序序列（1到500步，以`停止`结束），提交至官方模拟器回放。
- **目标**：安全到达指令目标，同时避免与人体碰撞。

## 阶段

- 第一阶段：在已发布的验证集已见（val_seen）和验证集未见（val_unseen）片段上进行开发。两个划分都会被报告；仅验证集未见的分数决定第一阶段排名。
- 第一阶段覆盖范围：为全部778个验证集已见片段和全部1,839个验证集未见片段提交动作。
- 第二阶段：在保留的测试评分数据上进行最终评估。测试分数决定最终排名和奖项。

第一阶段分数不决定入围或奖项，也不与第二阶段分数合并。每天最多提交5次，每阶段最多提交100次；保留最佳分数。

## 日程安排

1. 报名开始：2026年10月08日。
2. 第一阶段开放：2026年10月15日，截止：2026年10月30日。
3. 第二阶段开放：2026年10月30日，截止：2026年11月30日。
4. 奖项决定公布：2026年12月12日。

## 奖项与认可

1. **认可证书**：颁发给赛道2前5名团队的官方证书。
2. **最佳创新解决方案**：表彰杰出创意和技术创新的证书。
3. **口头报告**：精选的顶尖表现团队将被邀请在NeurIPS 2026 RoboPAD研讨会上进行口头报告。

最终排名和奖项完全由第二阶段测试评估决定。

## 资料与工具包

- [挑战赛代码库和参赛工具包](https://github.com/roboworld2026/track2)：文档、数据下载脚本、基线设置和动作提交导出器。
- [赛道网站](https://roboworld2026.github.io/track2)：官方赛道详情和公告。
- [HA-VLN 2.0](https://uwmilab.github.io/HA-VLN-webpage/)：项目页面和[官方代码库](https://github.com/UWMILab/HA-VLN)。
- 入门套件：下载附加于本次竞赛的第一阶段入门套件，获取官方片段清单、示例提交和本地验证器。

## 报名

通过 [Google表单](https://roboworld2026.github.io/#registration)
（报名开放时间为2026年10月08日）注册您的团队，以获得排行榜、证书和参赛资格。

# Submission & Evaluation Both phases accept a single ZIP archive containing predicted action sequences for all required episodes. ## What the Submission Contains Submit one ZIP archive containing the action sequences for every episode in the phase manifest. > [!NOTE] > - **Phase 1 (Validation)** is open until **November 23, 2026 (Monday)** solely for development and validation testing, and does not determine final challenge awards. > - **Phase 2 (Final Evaluation)** alone determines final rankings and awards. All teams are eligible to participate in Phase 2 regardless of Phase 1 participation. ## Archive Layout ### Phase 2 (Final Evaluation) Place the prediction JSON file directly at the root of the ZIP archive: ```text submission.zip `-- test.json # 3,408 test episodes ``` Package Phase 2 predictions: ```bash zip -j submission.zip test.json ```
Phase 1 (Validation) Archive Layout (Click to expand) For Phase 1 validation development, place both validation split predictions at the archive root: ```text submission.zip |-- val_seen.json # 778 episodes `-- val_unseen.json # 1,839 episodes ``` Package Phase 1 predictions: ```bash zip -j submission.zip val_seen.json val_unseen.json ```
## Prediction File Structure Each JSON file must contain `format_version`, `split`, and `episodes`: ```json { "format_version": 1, "split": "test", "episodes": [ { "episode_id": "1", "actions": ["MOVE_FORWARD", "TURN_LEFT", "LOOK_UP", "LOOK_DOWN", "STOP"] } ] } ``` - `format_version`: Set to `1`. - `split`: Set to `"test"` for Phase 2 (3,408 episodes). For Phase 1 validation, use `"val_seen"` (778 episodes) and `"val_unseen"` (1,839 episodes). - `episodes`: A list of episode predictions covering all required episode IDs in the phase manifest. - `episode_id`: String identifier matching the manifest exactly once. - `actions`: An ordered list of 1 to 500 actions chosen from `["STOP", "MOVE_FORWARD", "TURN_LEFT", "TURN_RIGHT", "LOOK_UP", "LOOK_DOWN"]`. `"STOP"` may only appear as the final action. Sequences shorter than 500 actions must end with `"STOP"`; sequences reaching the 500-action limit may omit `"STOP"` if terminated by the step limit. ## Pre-upload Verification Before submitting to CodaBench, verify your archive using `check_submission.py` provided in the Starting Kit: ```bash python3 check_submission.py submission.zip ``` The checker validates archive integrity, JSON schema, action vocabulary, STOP placement, and episode coverage without requiring a GPU or simulator. ## Evaluation & Leaderboard Submissions are evaluated on navigation and social compliance, and ranked by the composite challenge **Score** (higher is better): - **SR** (higher is better): Collision-free navigation success rate to the target goal. - **NE** (lower is better): Mean Euclidean distance in metres from final agent position to goal. - **CR** (lower is better): Ratio of collision episodes over human-influenced episodes. - **TCR** (lower is better): Mean number of collision events per episode. ```text NE utility = 3 / (3 + NE) TCR utility = 1 / (1 + TCR) Navigation = 0.80 * SR + 0.20 * NE utility Social = 0.75 * (1 - CR) + 0.25 * TCR utility Score = 100 * Navigation * (0.70 + 0.30 * Social) ``` Phase 1 ranks teams by `val_unseen` Score (`val_seen` is reported for reference). Phase 2 ranks teams by `test` Score to determine final awards. When Scores are tied, rankings are broken in order: higher SR, lower NE, lower CR, lower TCR, and earlier submission time. Official evaluation replays submitted action sequences in the organizer-controlled CodaBench environment under standardized conditions. Human animations advance with wall-clock time according to the configured motion FPS (rather than advancing one frame per action). Official CodaBench replay results determine official competition rankings. ## Submission Limits Each team may submit up to 5 times per day and 100 times per phase. The leaderboard retains the team's highest Score. ## Support - **Frequently Asked Questions:** [Track 2 FAQ](https://github.com/roboworld2026/track2#-frequently-asked-questions) (please check the FAQ before emailing for common questions) - **Technical Support:** [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/roboworld2026/track2/issues) - **Contact Email:** [roboworld2026@gmail.com](mailto:roboworld2026@gmail.com)

# 提交与评估

两个阶段均接受包含所有所需回合预测动作序列的单个ZIP压缩包。

## 提交内容

提交一个ZIP压缩包，包含阶段清单中每个回合的动作序列。评估仅使用动作预测结果；无需提供模型权重、代码和外部环境资源。

## 归档结构

将预测JSON文件直接放在ZIP压缩包的根目录下：

```text
submission.zip
|-- val_seen.json      # 778 episodes
`-- val_unseen.json    # 1,839 episodes
```

第二阶段遵循相同的结构，在`submission_test.zip`中包含`test.json`。打包第一阶段预测结果：

```bash
zip -j submission.zip val_seen.json val_unseen.json
```

## 预测文件结构

每个JSON文件必须包含`format_version`、`split`和`episodes`：

```json
{
  "format_version": 1,
  "split": "val_unseen",
  "episodes": [
    {
      "episode_id": "synthetic-example-001",
      "actions": ["MOVE_FORWARD", "TURN_LEFT", "LOOK_UP", "LOOK_DOWN", "STOP"]
    }
  ]
}
```

- `format_version`：设置为`1`。
- `split`：`"val_seen"`、`"val_unseen"`或`"test"`，与对应阶段匹配。
- `episodes`：包含清单中所有回合ID的预测列表。
  - `episode_id`：与清单完全匹配的字符串标识符，每个回合只出现一次。
  - `actions`：从`["STOP", "MOVE_FORWARD", "TURN_LEFT", "TURN_RIGHT", "LOOK_UP", "LOOK_DOWN"]`中选择的1至500个动作的有序列表。`"STOP"`只能作为最后一个动作出现；短于500个动作的序列必须以`"STOP"`结尾。

## 评估与排行榜

提交结果根据导航和社交合规性进行评估，并按综合挑战**分数**进行排名（越高越好）：

- **SR**（越高越好）：到达目标的无碰撞导航成功率。
- **NE**（越低越好）：智能体最终位置到目标的平均欧几里得距离（米）。
- **CR**（越低越好）：碰撞回合与受人类影响回合的比率。
- **TCR**（越低越好）：每回合的平均碰撞事件次数。

```text
NE utility  = 3 / (3 + NE)
TCR utility = 1 / (1 + TCR)
Navigation  = 0.80 * SR + 0.20 * NE utility
Social      = 0.75 * (1 - CR) + 0.25 * TCR utility
Score       = 100 * Navigation * (0.70 + 0.30 * Social)
```

第一阶段根据`val_unseen`分数对队伍进行排名（`val_seen`分数仅供参考）。第二阶段根据`test`分数对队伍进行排名以确定最终奖项。当分数相同时，按以下顺序打破平局：更高的SR、更低的NE、更低的CR、更低的TCR、更早的提交时间。

## 提交限制

每支队伍每天最多可提交5次，每个阶段最多可提交100次。排行榜保留队伍的最高分数。

## 技术支持

- **技术支持：** [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/roboworld2026/track2/issues)  
- **赛事与注册：** [roboworld2026@gmail.com](mailto:roboworld2026@gmail.com)

pages.content: # RoboWorld 2026 Track 1: WorldNav Welcome to WorldNav, the language-conditioned visual navigation track of the RoboWorld 2026, affiliated with the RoboPAD Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. An agent receives one initial egocentric RGB image and a natural-language instruction. It must predict a complete navigation action sequence without a goal image, an initial numeric pose, or further observations from the environment. World models, vision-language-action models, and policy-only methods are welcome. ## Task Definition Submit variable-length sequences of `[dx, dy, dyaw]` actions. `dx` means forward motion and `dy` means leftward motion in the agent's current local frame; `dyaw` changes heading in radians. The private evaluator uses the recorded initial pose to reconstruct the predicted route. Test participants receive only the initial image and instruction, not the pose, goal, reference trajectory, or reference action sequence. ## Phases Phase 1 is for development and validation. Final rankings and awards are based entirely on Phase 2; phase scores are not combined. Phase 1 remains open for validation submissions during Phase 2. | Phase |   | Evaluation data |   | Ranking | |:--|:--:|:--|:--:|:--| | Phase 1: Validation |   | Released `val_seen` and `val_unseen` inputs |   | Mean of `val_seen` and `val_unseen` Scores (50% each) | | Phase 2: Final Evaluation |   | Held-out test inputs |   | Test Score | [Download Phase 2 Test Dataset](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QWGsRBB8KlS_v9Jf0S51C3SpKltL_ZPL?usp=sharing). ## Awards & Recognition Official challenge awards follow the [RoboWorld 2026 Awards & Recognition](https://roboworld2026.github.io/#awards) guidelines: - **Certificates of Recognition**: The **Top 5 teams in each track** will receive official certificates recognizing their achievements in the RoboWorld Challenge 2026. # Submission & Evaluation Submit predicted action sequences in a ZIP archive, using only each episode's initial RGB image and instruction. Each phase allows **5 submissions per day and 200 in total per participant**. ## Action format Each action is [dx, dy, dyaw]: forward displacement, leftward displacement in the agent's **current local frame**, and yaw update in radians. Sequences may have different lengths; the JSON list ends the trajectory. Limits: at most 64 actions per episode; hypot(dx,dy) ≤ 2.46 dataset coordinate units and |dyaw| ≤ 6.29 rad per action (evaluated modulo 2π in [−π, π)). ## ZIP layout ### Phase 2: Final Evaluation Put `test.json` directly at the archive root and include all 15,303 test episodes: ```text submission.zip └── test.json ``` ```bash zip -j submission.zip test.json ``` Download the Phase 2 example ZIP from **Files** and replace its illustrative actions.
Phase 1: Validation archive layout (click to expand) Both `val_seen.json` and `val_unseen.json` are required at the archive root: ```text submission.zip ├── val_seen.json └── val_unseen.json ``` ```bash zip -j submission.zip val_seen.json val_unseen.json ```
### JSON schema Each file contains split and episodes. Include every phase episode_id exactly once, with an actions list: { "split": "test", "episodes": [ { "episode_id": "LCVN_test_00001", "actions": [[0.25, 0.0, 0.0], [0.0, 0.0, 0.15], [0.12, -0.05, 0.0]] } ] } This abbreviated example is not a complete submission. Phase 1 uses the corresponding validation split name and its original episode IDs. ## Evaluation metrics The two fidelity metrics range from 0 to 1. See [demonstration.py](https://github.com/roboworld2026/track1/blob/main/demonstration.py) for the five calculations. | Metric |   | Direction |   | Meaning | | :-- | :--: | :-- | :--: | :-- | | **Success Rate (SR)** |   | Higher |   | Fraction meeting the final-position success criterion. | | **Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE)** |   | Lower |   | Position error over the reference trajectory. | | **Relative Pose Error (RPE)** |   | Lower |   | Relative translation error between consecutive poses. | | **Full-route fidelity** |   | Higher |   | Agreement with the complete ordered recorded route, including a penalty for unnecessary travel. | | **Heading and turn fidelity** |   | Higher |   | Agreement of facing direction while moving and of the direction, position, and amount of turns. | ## Composite Score Each episode is scored first, then the contributions are averaged: Score = (100/N) × Σ_i { FullRouteFidelity_i × (1 + HeadingTurnFidelity_i)/2 × [0.70 + 0.10 SR_i + 0.10/(1+ATE_i) + 0.10/(1+RPE_i)] } SR_i is binary success; ATE_i and RPE_i are per-episode errors in dataset coordinate units. Score averages episode contributions. Phase 1 ranks by `(Score_val_seen + Score_val_unseen) / 2`, with equal weight for each split. Both split files are required; a submission missing either file is rejected. Both split Scores are displayed. Phase 2 ranks by test Score.

# 提交与评估

将预测的动作序列提交至ZIP压缩包，仅使用每个片段的初始RGB图像和指令。

## 动作格式

每个动作为[dx, dy, dyaw]：前向位移、智能体**当前局部坐标系**中的左向位移，以及偏航角更新（弧度制）。序列长度可不同；JSON列表标记轨迹结束。

限制：每个片段最多64个动作；单次动作的hypot(dx,dy) ≤ 2.46数据集坐标单位且|dyaw| ≤ 6.29弧度（在[−π, π)范围内对2π取模计算）。

## ZIP文件结构

将所需的JSON文件置于压缩包根目录。可下载的示例ZIP展示了文件结构和第一阶段片段ID；替换其中的示例动作。

| 阶段 |   | 所需文件 |
| :-- | :--: | :-- |
| 第一阶段 |   | val_seen.json, val_unseen.json |
| 第二阶段 |   | test.json |

### JSON模式

每个文件包含数据集划分和片段。每个阶段的episode_id必须且只能出现一次，附带动作列表：

    {
      "split": "val_unseen",
      "episodes": [
        {
          "episode_id": "20210826_40_0001_02_0",
          "actions": [[0.25, 0.0, 0.0], [0.0, 0.0, 0.15], [0.12, -0.05, 0.0]]
        }
      ]
    }

此简化示例并非完整提交。

## 评估指标

两个保真度指标范围为0到1。五种计算方法参见[demonstration.py](https://github.com/F1y1113/worldnav-challenge/blob/main/demonstration.py)。

| 指标 |   | 方向 |   | 含义 |
| :-- | :--: | :-- | :--: | :-- |
| **成功率 (SR)** |   | 越高越好 |   | 满足最终位置成功标准的比例。 |
| **绝对轨迹误差 (ATE)** |   | 越低越好 |   | 相对于参考轨迹的位置误差。 |
| **相对位姿误差 (RPE)** |   | 越低越好 |   | 连续位姿之间的相对平移误差。 |
| **全路径保真度** |   | 越高越好 |   | 与完整有序记录路径的一致性，包括对不必要移动的惩罚。 |
| **航向与转向保真度** |   | 越高越好 |   | 移动时朝向以及转向方向、位置和幅度的一致性。 |

## 综合得分

首先对每个片段进行评分，然后取平均值：

    Score = (100/N) × Σ_i { FullRouteFidelity_i × (1 + HeadingTurnFidelity_i)/2
                          × [0.70 + 0.10 SR_i + 0.10/(1+ATE_i) + 0.10/(1+RPE_i)] }

SR_i为二元成功标志；ATE_i和RPE_i为每个片段在数据集坐标单位下的误差。得分取各片段贡献的平均值。

第一阶段按`(Score_val_seen + Score_val_unseen) / 2`排名，两个划分权重相等。两个划分的文件都必须提交；缺少任一文件的提交将被拒绝。两个划分的得分均会显示。第二阶段按测试集得分排名。

pages.content:
# 🩺 
# **OncoSegment: Breast Tumor Mapping Challenge**

# 💡 
## **Why this Problem is Interesting**

Breast cancer remains one of the leading causes of death among women worldwide. Early and accurate detection through ultrasound is critical, but interpreting these images is notoriously difficult.Ultrasound images suffer from "speckle noise" and low contrast. Much like the "blobs" in plasma physics simulations, tumors in ultrasound are intermittent, have irregular boundaries, and can be easily confused with healthy tissue. This challenge asks you to develop an AI that can precisely outline tumor boundaries, a task that directly assists radiologists in biopsy planning and treatment.

# 📊 
## **The Data**

The dataset is derived from the Breast Ultrasound Images (BUSI) collection, featuring women aged 25–75. It consists of high-quality PNG scans with a standard resolution (approx. 500x500 px).

Dataset Breakdown:

Benign: Tumors that are typically oval or round with smooth edges.

Malignant: Cancerous tumors, often characterized by "spiky" (spiculated) or irregular borders that invade surrounding tissue.

Normal: Scans with no tumors (used to test your model's ability to avoid False Positives).

What you receive in the Starting Kit:
train_images: A list of PIL images (Grayscale) showing the breast 
tissue.
train_masks: Binary masks where 1 represents the tumor and 0 represents the background.
train_labels: Metadata identifying the tumor as benign or malignant.
test_images: Images where you must predict the mask.

 # 📏 
## **Metrics: Measuring Precision**

In medical imaging, a "box" is not enough. We need to know exactly which pixels are cancerous. We use two complementary overlap metrics:
1. Primary Metric: Dice Coefficient (F1-Score)The Dice coefficient is the gold standard for medical segmentation. It is twice the area of overlap divided by the total number of pixels in both the prediction and the ground truth.
$$Dice = \frac{2 \times |P \cap G|}{|P| + |G|}$$
Why? It is highly sensitive to the internal "fullness" of the mask and rewards models that get the shape exactly right.
2. Secondary Metric: Jaccard Index (IoU)
The Jaccard index is the area of intersection divided by the area of union.
$$Jaccard = \frac{|P \cap G|}{|P \cup G|}$$
Why? 
It is more "punishing" than Dice for small errors.
It helps break ties on the leaderboard by highlighting models with the fewest stray False Positive pixels.
pages.content_zh:
# 🩺 
# **OncoSegment：乳腺肿瘤分割挑战赛**

# 💡 
## **为什么这个问题很有意义**

乳腺癌仍然是全球女性死亡的主要原因之一。通过超声进行早期准确检测至关重要，但解读这些图像出了名的困难。超声图像存在"散斑噪声"和对比度低的问题。就像等离子体物理模拟中的"团块"一样，超声中的肿瘤呈散在分布，边界不规则，很容易与健康组织混淆。本挑战赛要求你开发一种能够精确勾画肿瘤边界的AI，这项任务直接协助放射科医生进行活检规划和治疗。

# 📊 
## **数据**

该数据集源自乳腺超声图像（BUSI）数据集，涵盖25-75岁女性。它由高质量的PNG扫描图像组成，标准分辨率约为500×500像素。

数据集分类：

良性：通常为椭圆形或圆形、边缘光滑的肿瘤。

恶性：癌性肿瘤，通常以"棘状"（毛刺状）或不规则边界为特征，侵袭周围组织。

正常：没有肿瘤的扫描图像（用于测试模型避免假阳性的能力）。

入门套件提供的内容：
train_images：一组显示乳腺组织的PIL图像（灰度）。
train_masks：二值掩膜，其中1代表肿瘤，0代表背景。
train_labels：识别肿瘤为良性或恶性的元数据。
test_images：你需要预测其掩膜的图像。

 # 📏 
## **评估指标：衡量精确度**

在医学影像中，仅用一个"框"是不够的。我们需要准确知道哪些像素是癌变的。我们使用两种互补的重叠指标：
1. 主要指标：Dice系数（F1分数）Dice系数是医学分割的金标准。它是预测掩膜与真实掩膜重叠区域面积的两倍，除以两者像素总数。
$$Dice = \frac{2 \times |P \cap G|}{|P| + |G|}$$
为什么？它对掩膜内部的"饱满度"非常敏感，并奖励那些能准确把握形状的模型。
2. 次要指标：Jaccard指数（IoU）
Jaccard指数是交集面积除以并集面积。
$$Jaccard = \frac{|P \cap G|}{|P \cup G|}$$
为什么？
对于微小的错误，它比Dice更"惩罚性强"。
它通过突出显示具有最少游离假阳性像素的模型，帮助在排行榜上打破平局。

# How to Participate

## Step 1: Create a Codabench Account

Visit Codabench.org and click Sign Up in the upper right corner. You will need to provide a name and a valid email address. Once registered, you can browse and join any public benchmark.

## Step 2: Register for Ego-IRGBench

Go to the Ego-IRG Challenge competition page and click the My Submissions tab. You will be prompted to accept the competition's Terms and Conditions. Since this is a public challenge with auto-approval enabled, you will be able to participate immediately after accepting the rules.

## Step 3: Download the Dataset and Prepare Your Model

The Ego-IRGBench dataset is hosted on [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/yuki3585/Ego-IEGBench). Download and prepare the data according to the instructions in the official [ANNEXE repository](https://yuggiehk.github.io/annexe/). The dataset contains over 20k egocentric images with 1.6M query-answer-mask pairs, organized into train, validation, and test splits.

Train your model on the training set and generate predictions on the test set.

## Step 4: Prepare Your Submission ZIP

Your submission must be a single ZIP file (.zip) with the following structure:

```text
submission/
├── results.json            # Main results file (required)
├── mask/                   # Predicted pixel grounding masks (required)
│   ├── <query_id>.png
│   └── ...
├── depth/                  # Predicted depth maps (optional)
│   └── <image_id>.png
└── README.md               # Method summary (optional)
```

### results.json Format

The JSON submission format is composed of a single JSON array containing entries for every query in all the images of the test set. Specifically, the JSON file should contain a list of objects, each with the following properties:
-	an *id* property, reporting the unique identifier of the query (e.g., 36331).
-	an *image_id* property, reporting the filename of the input egocentric image (e.g., ZY20210800002_H2_C5_N14_S121_s02_T3_00010.png). Multiple queries on the same image share the same image_id.
-	a *query* property, reporting the input VQA query, copied verbatim from the test set (e.g., "Please analyze the interaction in the image and segment the active objects.").
-	an *answer_vqa* property, reporting the predicted answer to the VQA query (answering sub-task). This should identify which objects need to be segmented, using <MSK>, <MSK_0>, <MSK_1>, ... placeholders (e.g., "The mask of the active toy car is <MSK>."). For no-target queries, the answer should indicate that no suitable results were found.
-	an *answer_caption* property, reporting the predicted interaction description (analyzing sub-task). This is a fluent, natural-language summary of the interaction depicted in the image (e.g., "A toy car is held by the right hand of the person in this image.").
-	a *mask* property, reporting the path to the predicted mask file relative to the mask/directory (e.g., "mask/36331.png"). For multi-target queries with N masks, provide a comma-separated list of paths or a single combined mask file. For no-target queries (with_mask: 0), set to null.
-	a *with_mask* property, reporting the mask existence indicator as an integer ('0' or '1'). '1' if the query refers to at least one object present in the image; '0' otherwise.


Example results.json:
```
{[
  "id": 36331,
  "image_id": "ZY20210800002_H2_C5_N14_S121_s02_T3_00010.png",
  "query": "Please analyze the interaction in the image and segment the active objects.",
  "answer_vqa": "The mask of the active toy car is <MSK>.",
  "answer_caption": "A toy car is held by the right hand of the person in this image.",
  "mask": "mask/36331.png",
  "with_mask": 1]
}
```

### Important Notes

For multi-target queries with N masks, provide a single combined mask file.
For no-target queries (with_mask: 0), set mask to null.
The query field must be copied verbatim from the test set — do not paraphrase.
Mask files must be PNG images placed under the mask/ directory, named by query ID.
	
## Step 5: Upload Your Submission

Return to the My Submissions tab on the competition page.
Click the paper clip icon and select your ZIP file.
Your submission will be processed automatically. Once complete, you can view your score on the Results tab (Leaderboard).
	
## Step 6: Check the Leaderboard

Your score will appear on the leaderboard after evaluation. You may submit multiple times per day during the development phase. The final ranking is determined by your best submission.

# 如何参与

## 步骤1：创建Codabench账户

访问 Codabench.org 并点击右上角的"注册"。您需要提供姓名和有效的电子邮件地址。注册完成后，您可以浏览并加入任何公开的基准测试。

## 步骤2：注册Ego-IRGBench

前往 Ego-IRG Challenge 竞赛页面，点击"我的提交"标签。系统将提示您接受竞赛的条款和条件。由于这是一个启用了自动批准的公开挑战赛，您在接受规则后即可立即参与。

## 步骤3：下载数据集并准备模型

Ego-IRGBench 数据集托管在 [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/yuki3585/Ego-IEGBench) 上。请根据官方 [ANNEXE 仓库](https://yuggiehk.github.io/annexe/) 中的说明下载并准备数据。该数据集包含超过 2 万张第一人称视角图像，带有 160 万个查询-答案-掩码对，分为训练集、验证集和测试集。

在训练集上训练您的模型，并在测试集上生成预测结果。

## 步骤4：准备提交的ZIP文件

您的提交必须是单个 ZIP 文件（.zip），结构如下：

```text
submission/
├── results.json            # 主要结果文件（必需）
├── mask/                   # 预测的像素级定位掩码（必需）
│   ├── <query_id>.png
│   └── ...
├── depth/                  # 预测的深度图（可选）
│   └── <image_id>.png
└── README.md               # 方法摘要（可选）
```

### results.json 格式

JSON 提交格式由单个 JSON 数组组成，包含测试集中所有图像的每个查询条目。具体而言，JSON 文件应包含一个对象列表，每个对象具有以下属性：
- *id* 属性，报告查询的唯一标识符（例如，36331）。
- *image_id* 属性，报告输入的第一人称视角图像的文件名（例如，ZY20210800002_H2_C5_N14_S121_s02_T3_00010.png）。同一图像上的多个查询共享相同的 image_id。
- *query* 属性，报告输入的视觉问答（VQA）查询，从测试集中逐字复制（例如，"Please analyze the interaction in the image and segment the active objects."）。
- *answer_vqa* 属性，报告对 VQA 查询的预测答案（回答子任务）。这应该识别需要分割哪些对象，使用 <MSK>、<MSK_0>、<MSK_1>、... 等占位符（例如，"The mask of the active toy car is <MSK>."）。对于无目标查询，答案应表明未找到合适的结果。
- *answer_caption* 属性，报告预测的交互描述（分析子任务）。这是对图像中所描绘交互的流畅自然语言总结（例如，"A toy car is held by the right hand of the person in this image."）。
- *mask* 属性，报告相对于 mask/ 目录的预测掩码文件路径（例如，"mask/36331.png"）。对于具有 N 个掩码的多目标查询，提供逗号分隔的路径列表或单个合并的掩码文件。对于无目标查询（with_mask: 0），设置为 null。
- *with_mask* 属性，报告掩码存在指示符，为整数（'0' 或 '1'）。如果查询涉及图像中至少一个对象，则为 '1'；否则为 '0'。

results.json 示例：
```
{[
  "id": 36331,
  "image_id": "ZY20210800002_H2_C5_N14_S121_s02_T3_00010.png",
  "query": "Please analyze the interaction in the image and segment the active objects.",
  "answer_vqa": "The mask of the active toy car is <MSK>.",
  "answer_caption": "A toy car is held by the right hand of the person in this image.",
  "mask": "mask/36331.png",
  "with_mask": 1]
}
```

### 重要说明

对于具有 N 个掩码的多目标查询，请提供单个合并的掩码文件。
对于无目标查询（with_mask: 0），将 mask 设置为 null。
query 字段必须从测试集中逐字复制——不要改写。
掩码文件必须是放置在 mask/ 目录下的 PNG 图像

##
Pan-cancer Segmentation in CT Images (Task2): RECIST to 3D
--- Organ and cancer segmentation in medical images, especially from 3D CT scans, is fundamentally important for accurate diagnosis, treatment planning, and monitoring the progression of diseases. This competition aims to facilitate the development of pan-cancer segmentation models in general CT scans with three main features: - [RECIST](https://doi.org/10.3389/fonc.2021.800547) (2D diameter marker) to 3D segmentation on laptop (without using GPU during inference) - Dataset: 10,000+ CT scans, covering whole-body cancer types - Evaluation Metrics: segmentation accuracy (DSC, NSD) and segmentation efficiency (running time and GPU consumption with tolerance) --- ## 🚀 Join the challenge (2026.04.01-8.30) #### Step 1. Join the challenge and download the data * Register an account on this website and join the challenge * Fill out the [registration form](https://forms.gle/my1MimQ758oDyhWb9). Note: To change team information, please simply re-submit the form. * Request Dataset [Subtask 2](https://huggingface.co/datasets/FLARE-MedFM/FLARE-Task1-PancancerRECIST-to-3D) * Submit the [Task2-baseline](https://drive.google.com/file/d/16nz_2UJLvsaVoqF1_oIWffu7J6UaU5UA/view?usp=drive_link) on [My Submission](https://www.codabench.org/competitions/7149/#/participate-tab) to test your account. Note: * Participants can join just one subtask or both tasks. * Public pre-trained models are allowed to use but please first post the model link in [forum](https://www.codabench.org/forums/7048/1161/) by April 1, 2026. --- ## 🏊‍ Validation submission (2026.4.20-8.30) * All teams can directly submit the segmentation results on the challenge page to get the segmentation accuracy metrics. * All teams can also make docker submissions. To avoid submission jams, each team can make one docker submission per month. * To make docker submissions, please send us (medseg20s@gmail.com): (Email subject: PanCancerSeg-YourTeamName-TeamLeaderName-Validation Submission) (1) a download link to your Docker container (teamname.tar.gz). (2) a sanity test video record. Please test your docker on validation cases and record the prediction process. For each case, the running time should be within 60s. * When the evaluation is finished, we will return back the metrics via email. ### Baseline Repo:https://github.com/medfm-flare/MedSAM2-RECIST ### Baseline result download [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/16nz_2UJLvsaVoqF1_oIWffu7J6UaU5UA/view?usp=drive_link) (Same in step1) ### Submission format Submit a single ZIP whose contents sit in one flat directory (no sub-folders): ``` submission.zip ├── Colon_001.npz # one .npz per case ├── Kidney_001.npz ├── Liver_001.npz └── ... ``` **Segmentation masks** — one file per case, named `{identifier}.npz` (e.g. `Colon_001.npz`), stored under the array key `segs`, dtype `uint8`, with the same shape as the input `imgs` array `(D, H, W)`. ```python np.savez_compressed("Colon_001.npz", segs=segs.astype(np.uint8)) ``` **Instance labels must be preserved** — lesion `k` is labeled with id `k`, matching the id of its RECIST prompt in the input `recist` array: | Input `recist` label | Your `segs` label | Scored against | |---|---|---| | `1` | `1` | GT lesion `1` | | `2` | `2` | GT lesion `2` | | `3` | `3` | GT lesion `3` | Metrics are computed **per lesion**, so a mask that merges all lesions into label `1` scores near zero on multi-lesion cases. **Metrics:** | Metric | Description | |---|---| | `Lesion_DSC` | Dice, computed per lesion id | | `Lesion_NSD` | Normalized Surface Distance per lesion id, tolerance = 1.0 mm | Notes: * Do **not** wrap the files in a top-level folder — the scorer looks for `{identifier}.npz` directly, so a nested directory means every case is reported missing and the score is 0. * Filenames must match the test-set identifiers exactly (case-sensitive) so predictions can be paired with the ground truth; missing cases are scored 0. * A `segs` shape that differs from the reference volume scores the whole case 0. * Every lesion id present in the reference counts toward the case mean, so missed lesions are penalized rather than skipped. Extra ids not present in the reference are ignored. * Efficiency (runtime / memory) is not measured by the scoring program. --- ## 🏹 Testing submission (2026.9.1-9.7) * To avoid overfitting the testing set, **we only offer one successful submission opportunity on the testing set**. * The submission should include: (Email subject: PanCancerSeg-YourTeamName-TeamLeaderName-Testing Submission) (1) a download link to your Docker container (teamname.tar.gz); (2) a sanity test video record (download [example](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uwbvYaSDQSxUT-yzGvuVcn6Ed3zNV1B3/view)). Please test your docker on validation cases and record the prediction process. For each case, the running time should be within 60s. * The submitted Docker container will be evaluated with the following commands. Otherwise, only certificates will be provided. - The winning teams will be invited to give oral presentations. - The first author of the top 3 teams will be invited to contribute to a challenge summary paper. - A certificate will be awarded to the top 10 teams.
